Squaring and tracing, the fourth harmonics vanish because Tr(T^4)=0; cyclic trace identities yield the stated constant term and 4ts(t^2+s^2)Re(e^{2iθ}Tr(T^3T*)). Maximizing and minimizing the real part gives the exact radius and oscillation. The kernel filtration K_j=ker T^j makes T strictly block upper triangular; Tr(T^3T*) is the Hilbert–Schmidt inner product of A12 A23 A34 with A14. The four-factor Hilbert–Schmidt bound and AM–GM give |gamma|<=||T||_2^4/16. Equality in each inequality forces the unused blocks to vanish and the four remaining blocks to be aligned rank-one maps of equal Hilbert–Schmidt norm, giving the four-dimensional path-plus-shortcut form.
